commentary.analyst_note: Neutral confirmed for month 43 (composite +0.169z, display 3.2/5) with broadly flat 3-month momentum (+0.017z). Breadth at 62%: primary drag is inflation, main support from stress. The composite sits 0.18z from the upgrade boundary; the more likely regime change — if it comes — would arrive through the inflation pillar rather than a broad deterioration.
commentary.author: MRS Agent

labels.baseline: Base case: tariff-drag slowdown with gradual disinflation. Fed holds H1, cuts 50bp H2. No recession.
labels.optimistic: Upside: inflation normalises faster, growth holds above trend, Fed cuts 75bp. Soft landing.
labels.pessimistic: Downside: tariff-stagflation — growth disappoints, inflation stays sticky, conditions tighten.

indicators.label: Nonfarm Payrolls (3m avg)
indicators.notes: Tariff uncertainty slowing hiring pace; 3m avg declining but no recessionary signal

indicators.label: Industrial Production Mfg (YoY)
indicators.notes: Manufacturing IP faces tariff headwind on imported inputs; estimated from trend and PMI data

indicators.label: Real GDP (YoY)
indicators.notes: Quarterly, forward-filled monthly. Q2 2026 soft from tariff drag; partial recovery in H2 as policy uncertainty fades

indicators.label: Real Services Spending (YoY)
indicators.forecastRaw: 2.0–2.3% real YoY → gradual decel to ~1.7% by Q2 2027
indicators.notes: Services consumption resilient but decelerating; tariff pass-through risk on goods-adjacent services

indicators.label: Core PCE Deviation from 2% Target
indicators.notes: Inflation pillar primary drag; baseline assumes tariff pass-through is one-time, not persistent

indicators.label: Core PCE Momentum (6m change in YoY)
indicators.forecastRaw: Decelerating: momentum turns positive as base effects help H2 2026
indicators.notes: 6M change in core PCE YoY; improving as 2025 tariff spike rolls off the base

indicators.label: Financial Conditions Index (NFCI)
indicators.forecastRaw: Slight easing: NFCI normalises as rate cut expectations build
indicators.notes: Fed funds futures imply 2 cuts in H2 2026; NFCI should ease gradually

indicators.label: Yield Curve (10Y-2Y)
indicators.forecastRaw: Normalising: 10Y-2Y → +0bps to +30bps range as Fed cuts front end
indicators.notes: Curve inversion (-60bp currently) expected to normalise with Fed cuts; not recessionary inversion at current level

indicators.label: Credit Spread Level (BAA-10Y)
indicators.forecastRaw: Normalising from historically tight: spreads widen modestly to ~120-130bp from ~100bp
indicators.notes: Current spreads at 23-year tight; expected to widen modestly as growth slows but no recession-level widening

indicators.label: Credit Spread Momentum (6m change)
indicators.forecastRaw: Deteriorating: spreads widening vs 6m ago as tightening cycle reverses
indicators.notes: Momentum turns negative as current tight spreads start widening vs the 6m-lagged base

indicators.label: VIX (monthly average)
indicators.forecastRaw: VIX normalises toward 18-20 range as trade policy uncertainty eases
indicators.notes: Current VIX near long-run avg; baseline assumes gradual drift lower as uncertainty resolves

indicators.label: Bond / Financial Stress Index
indicators.forecastRaw: Stable: bond vol stays low, no acute stress event expected
indicators.source: St. Louis Fed / FRED DGS10 / market-implied
indicators.notes: DGS10 realized vol currently low; baseline assumes slow drift lower as curve normalises

indicators.label: Equity Drawdown (SPY from peak)
indicators.forecastRaw: Mild correction risk: SPY drawdown drifts to -3% to -5% range
indicators.notes: Currently near all-time high (0% drawdown); baseline assumes modest correction as growth slows
